I am old now, seventy-eight years, and this small maize plot behind the house is only a small piece — maybe a quarter of an acre. I have some schooling so I know fertilizer helps maize, but one bag of urea or CAN is too much for this little plot and costs too much for me to buy alone. I will put the manure from my few animals on it like I always do, and I intercrop with beans so the soil stays alive. I keep my own seed from last season because the improved seed needs fertilizer to pay off, and here in Iringa the rains are usually good so I do not need to irrigate. At my age I work slowly, so my son and grandchildren help me weed.
